about: Metadata for the Zenodo records Atlas archives to (R/archive.R). {grid} is replaced with the grid name. Creators, licence and community are settled here, in the open, and apply to every future version.

models.title: MycoMap Atlas: habitat models for North American fungi ({grid} grid)
models.summary: Habitat suitability maps and scores for every North American fungus with enough DNA-validated MycoMap collections to model, fitted three ways (Maxent, boosted trees, down-sampled random forest) against a target-group background and scored on spatially blocked folds.

layers.title: MycoMap Atlas: environmental predictors for North America ({grid} grid)
layers.summary: The 33 environmental predictors every Atlas model is fitted on (climate, elevation, terrain, topsoil and land cover), reprojected onto one North America Albers Equal Area grid.
